reprojection.method: Recomputed OPENCV_FISHEYE projection of every valid observation, not the zero-valued writer point.error field.

floor.interpretation: Independent least-squares fit of the near-ground sparse support band. Does not establish measured metric scale.

trajectory.note: Units inherit the assumed1.5m camera-height scale. Late low camera positions agree with the rolled/downward raw footage.

secondary.warning: Diagnostic alignment only, never applied. Native rejected its merge; keep isolated rather than invent a seam.
